SCHEDULE 10

This Schedule reproduces Article 3(2)(a) and Table A to Annex 1 of Directive 96/26/Euratom.

Article 3

2. No reporting need be required for practices involving the following:

(a)   radioactive substances where the quantities involved do not exceed in total the exemption values set out in column 2 of Table A to Annex I or, in exceptional circumstances in an individual Member State, different values authorized by the competent authorities that nevertheless satisfy the basic general criteria set out in Annex I.
